name: Patient 101: Frequent PVCs (Ventricular Ectopy)
desc: High ventricular ectopic burden (>15%) with frequent wide QRS complexes.

name: Patient 102: Isolated PVC (Sporadic Ectopy)
desc: Normal sinus background with occasional sporadic premature ventricular contractions.

name: Patient 103: Ventricular Couplet / Run
desc: Back-to-back premature ventricular beats forming couplets.

name: Patient 104: Supraventricular Tachycardia (Frequent PACs)
desc: Rapid atrial ectopic tachycardia with narrow QRS and compensatory cadence.

name: Patient 105: Isolated PAC (Atrial Ectopy)
desc: Premature atrial contraction occurring within standard sinus rhythm.

name: Patient 106: Marked Sinus Bradycardia (<50 BPM)
desc: Sustained severe resting bradycardia under 50 beats per minute.

name: Patient 107: Moderate Sinus Bradycardia (52 BPM)
desc: Slow resting sinus rhythm crossing the clinical 60 BPM bradycardia threshold.

name: Patient 108: Severe Sinus Tachycardia (164 BPM)
desc: Extreme sinus tachycardia with rapid ventricular response.

name: Patient 109: Sinus Tachycardia (113 BPM)
desc: Sustained sinus rate exceeding 100 BPM with normal morphology.

name: Patient 110: Irregular Rhythm (Possible A-Fib)
desc: Elevated nRMSSD (>0.20) showing chaotic R-R intervals characteristic of atrial fibrillation.

name: Patient 111: Normal Sinus Rhythm (Standard 76 BPM)
desc: Clean benchmark normal sinus rhythm with uniform cadence and morphology.

name: Patient 112: Resting Sinus Rhythm (High Vagal HRV)
desc: Resting normal rhythm with healthy parasympathetic autonomic tone (high RMSSD).
